criteria.name: D1_frozen_beats_bare_post_shift
criteria.statistic: TRIPLE-gated (red-team fix 2026-09-03): mean(auroc_move_ok_post_frozen - auroc_bare_move_ok_post) >= max(0.050, 1.0*sd) AND mean(auroc_move_ok_post_frozen - 0.5) >= max(0.050, 1.0*sd) AND mean(auroc_move_ok_post_frozen - auroc_shuffled_move_ok_post) >= max(0.050, 1.0*sd)

criteria.name: D2_readapted_beats_bare_post_shift
criteria.statistic: TRIPLE-gated (red-team fix 2026-09-03): mean(auroc_move_ok_post_readapted - auroc_bare_move_ok_post) >= max(0.050, 1.0*sd) AND mean(auroc_move_ok_post_readapted - 0.5) >= max(0.050, 1.0*sd) AND mean(auroc_move_ok_post_readapted - auroc_shuffled_move_ok_post) >= max(0.050, 1.0*sd)
criteria.description: cheap re-derivability under shift (8 epochs on 15% of the post-shift data, vs 60 epochs for the original fit); NOTE: does not have a scratch-model / unshifted-env positive control -- documented residual limitation, see module docstring

claim_scope.what_this_run_measures: NARROWED READING (red-team finding 3, second pass 2026-09-04 -- carried here from the module docstring's SCOPE LIMITATION so governance reading this manifest field directly sees it, not only readers of the source): whether SD-031's single-pass world-stream comparator's residual remains, or is cheaply reacquired as, ACTION-CONDITIONED under a structural relabelling of the environment's action->effect mapping that holds surface statistics fixed (the operative test is beating the arm's OWN action-shuffled control, per Richens & Everitt ICLR 2024's robustness-under-shift criterion). This is a real, relevant instance of that criterion but a NARROWER claim than 'REE has a genuine causal model' in the fullest sense: the environment's physics is itself a small lookup table, so no result here should be read as settling the deeper question -- only whether the comparator's action-conditioning specifically survives or is reacquired under relabelling. ARC-037's own E3/E1 routing/gating is NOT exercised here (comparator-only, same scope as 995); MECH-095 (TPJ agency comparator) and EXT-005 (llm.causal_attribution) are evidenced only via the same remedy-scoped reading 995 used -- neither MECH-095's TPJ implementation nor an LLM is observed by any V3 run.
claim_scope.attribution_caveat: READ THE DIRECTION AS SCOPED TO THE REE-SIDE REMEDY, NOT THE LLM-SIDE ASSERTION, identically to 995's own caveat. A PASS (either D1 or D2) shows REE's comparator survives or cheaply recovers from a distributional shift of the kind the Richens & Everitt theorem uses to diagnose a genuine causal model; it is not independent evidence about LLM causal attribution. A FAIL shows REE's own comparator is ALSO a correlational shortcut under this test -- which is a stronger, more specific finding than 995 could produce, but still does not weaken the LLM-side assertion (if anything it is consistent with the gap being architecture-general).

requeue_semantics: substrate_not_ready_requeue is the skill-mandated self-route for a below-floor readiness precondition (including the five new to this design: action_map_genuinely_rewired, surface_statistics_preserved, pre_base_in_distribution_signature, shift_degrades_frozen_forward_fit, and readapt_does_not_regress_frozen_fit -- the last three added by the Step 4.5 red-team pass, 2026-09-04). It is a SIGNAL for governance, not an automated requeue.
combination_rule: overall PASS = D1 OR D2 (either zero-shot invariance or cheap post-shift re-derivation counts as OOD robustness in the Richens & Everitt sense -- their theorem is about a regret bound UNDER shift, i.e. capacity to hold or reacquire a correct model, not zero-shot invariance specifically). FALSIFIED only if NEITHER holds. Both D1 and D2 are load-bearing individually (either alone flips the label); label distinguishes WHICH form of robustness was found. All criteria additionally gated on every readiness precondition; a failed precondition self-routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_contributory), never a claim verdict.
dv_symmetry_declaration: DV for both D1 and D2 is a within-stratum (post-shift held-out MOVE_OK) AUROC minus the bare-delta AUROC on the same stratum -- monotone-rescaling / within-class-permutation symmetry group, same family as 995. Neither the action-map rewiring (POST_FROZEN) nor the brief continued training (POST_READAPT) is invariant under it -- both re-rank steps across the drift/no-drift boundary by construction (frozen: stale weights applied to a relabelled action space; readapted: gradient steps on new post-shift data).

preconditions.name: zworld_world_encoder_trained
preconditions.description: P0 warmup moved at least one split_encoder.world_encoder tensor, i.e. z_world is a prediction-trained encoder rather than a frozen random projection
preconditions.control: the P0 warmup itself, on the arm's own training env at the arm's own p0 episode count -- the phase whose stated job is to train the world model

preconditions.name: zworld_encodes_exogenous_change
preconditions.description: bare ||z_obs - z_prev|| AUROC for hazard-moved vs not, STAY stratum, measured pre- AND post-shift
preconditions.control: positive control -- agent cannot have caused the change

preconditions.name: move_ok_confound_absent
preconditions.description: bare ||z_obs - z_prev|| AUROC in MOVE_OK near chance, pre- AND post-shift (the shift never touches raw change magnitude by construction -- this confirms it empirically too)

preconditions.name: causal_class_events_sufficient
preconditions.description: min(n_drift, n_no_drift) in the POST-shift held-out MOVE_OK stratum (the verdict-scoring set)
preconditions.control: the exact precondition V3-EXQ-783 failed on

preconditions.name: e2world_action_pathway_live
preconditions.description: mean ||f(z,a_i) - f(z,a_j)|| AT INITIALISATION (PRE_BASE arm only -- POST arms start from PRE_BASE's already-live weights)

preconditions.name: action_map_genuinely_rewired
preconditions.description: count of the 4 movement actions whose post-shift displacement differs from its pre-shift (canonical) displacement
preconditions.control: sanity check that the single 4-cycle rotation is not an accidental no-op -- guaranteed by construction (no fixed points), verified per seed

preconditions.name: surface_statistics_preserved
preconditions.description: max absolute deviation between pre- and post-shift STAY / MOVE_OK / MOVE_BLOCKED / drift-event fractions
preconditions.control: the load-bearing design claim -- a permutation of interchangeable movement actions under a uniformly-random policy holds these marginals fixed in expectation; this measures the finite-sample deviation

preconditions.name: pre_base_in_distribution_signature
preconditions.description: PRE_BASE (in-distribution) comparator must itself be informative: mean(auroc_move_ok_pre) - 0.5 >= max(0.050, sd) AND mean(auroc_move_ok_pre - auroc_bare_move_ok_pre) >= max(0.050, sd)
preconditions.control: mirrors 995's own C1+C2 combined, on PRE_BASE only -- a failing in-distribution fit makes any post-shift D1/D2 FAIL uninterpretable (is it the shift, or was PRE_BASE never a real signature?)

preconditions.name: shift_degrades_frozen_forward_fit
preconditions.description: frozen model's post-shift held-out forward MSE minus its own PRE_BASE held-out forward MSE (same weights) -- must be positive in every seed, confirming the action-map rewiring actually degraded the frozen model's predictions (the manipulation reached the DV) rather than being invisible to it

preconditions.name: readapt_does_not_regress_frozen_fit
preconditions.description: frozen held-out forward MSE minus readapt's held-out forward MSE (same held-out post-shift data), minus max(1e-05, 5% of the shift-induced degradation frozen_mse-pre_mse) -- must be positive in every seed, i.e. the 120-optimizer-step readapt pass measurably reduced forward error, scaled to how much there was to recover, not merely a non-negative (possibly zero) delta
preconditions.control: readapt-budget non-vacuity check, not a full positive control (no scratch-model / unshifted-env ceiling -- documented residual limitation, see module docstring)

authoring_pilot.note: single-seed authoring pilot at reduced POST budget (POST_EPISODES_PER_PHASE=40, not the pre-registered 150); used ONLY to confirm thresholds are satisfiable and non-degenerate. Seed 42 is excluded from SEEDS so no scored seed is in-sample.
